summary: We developed a space health-monitoring system using a implemented chip, and a digital website. Astronauts can record and send their health information to ground control. We moslty used AI.
details: Our project uses a health-monitoring chip and wearable devices to collect astronauts health information, such as heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen levels, and body temperature. The data is sent to Earth so doctors can monitor astronauts and detect health problems early, help in keeping them safe
